segments.he: אָמַר רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל: מַעֲשֶׂה בְּצַיְדָּן כּוּ׳. מַאי תַּנָּא דְּקָתָנֵי מַעֲשֶׂה?
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said:» There was «an incident in» the city of «Tzaidan» involving one who said to his wife: This is your bill of divorce on the condition that you will give me my coat, and she lost his coat. And the Rabbis said that she should give him the value of that coat, and by doing so she fulfills the condition and is divorced. The Gemara asks: «What» did Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel «teach» before, such «that he» now «teaches» and cites «an incident» which is similar to it? This incident does not seem to be referring to what was stated immediately before in the mishna.
